verdict.rationale: Remote-desktop tools can plausibly offer a headless host mode or CLI-driven operation, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no headless mode, CLI, or CI usage for Parsec. The Teams API ("automate Parsec deployment", "API access for automation and reporting") is an adjacent admin/provisioning interface, not the ability to run the product itself headlessly or in CI, so it earns no credit here.
